fields.description: The employee raising this documentation request.
fields.label: Requester

fields.description: Create a new document, revise an existing one (which publishes a new version), or withdraw an existing one from use. Delete does NOT destroy anything — it marks the document inactive and revokes its Drive sharing, and a System Manager can reactivate it.
fields.label: Request Action

fields.description: Proposed title for the document being requested.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: What's needed and why — this becomes the AI drafting requirement in Processa.
fields.label: Requirement

fields.description: The existing guideline document (already cataloged in Document Register) this document should be generated from. Its real content is extracted and given to the AI — the AI does not invent the guideline itself.
fields.label: Source Guideline

fields.description: The existing published document being revised or withdrawn. Only active controlled documents can be picked — an already-withdrawn one has nothing to revise or withdraw, and input material is not a controlled document.
fields.label: Existing Document

fields.description: The document holding the content you want the revision to say — catalogue it on Document Register first (pasting its Drive link is enough) and tick Input Material. Its text is authoritative: the AI reformats it into the official template and may not add, remove or reword anything. Say what the change is for in Requirement; that guides the layout, not the wording.
fields.label: New Content Document

fields.description: Always the requester's line manager (Employee > Reports To) — not chosen manually.
fields.label: Approver

fields.description: Every revision shares one Drive file, so this link stays valid for the life of the document — it always opens the current version.
fields.label: Published Document

fields.description: Which revision of the document this request produced. Stamped at publish.
fields.label: Published Version

fields.description: The Processa instance running this request through Creation → Review → Approval → Publish.
fields.label: BPMN Process Instance
